reference: Huawei KML 25.1.0 with private GCC 12.3.1; not specified official KML 25.2.0

members.strategy: 已晋级T8-svepanel16原样三轮复测，建立本轮KML25.1/GCC12基线；后续以同版本新run和候选同分配交错比较。

From T8, use a 4-row x 32-column SVE update for complete 32-column regions of the large path. Reuse four L coefficients across four RHS vectors, preserving increasing-k FMA, one final C subtraction, KB256/CT64, packing, scheduling, tails and fallback. More X input bytes are an explicit tradeoff; test actual performance against T8.
